description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPSyncStatusModel class, which represents the synchronization status of LDAP in the OrangeHRM system. It implements a normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization and data filtering, encapsulating LDAP sync timestamps and status.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates LDAP synchronization status data, including timestamps and status, for API serialization in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an LDAPSyncStatus entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
